title: Machine Learning Algorithms: Detection Official Hajj and Umrah Travel Agency Based on Text and Metadata Analysis
reasoning: The paper presents a machine learning system for detecting fraudulent mobile applications in the Hajj and Umrah travel sector. While the application domain is religious pilgrimage, the core research involves evaluating security classifiers (SVM, Random Forest, Naive Bayes) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious theology, faith, ethics, or morals itself.
